manifest.description: Move the XY gantry to an absolute position from the calibrated origin.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that should receive the XY gantry command.

inputs.label: X Position (cm)
inputs.description: Target X position measured from the calibrated origin.

inputs.label: Y Position (cm)
inputs.description: Target Y position measured from the calibrated origin.

inputs.label: Speed Profile
inputs.description: Named speed preset for the XY motion controller.

advanced_inputs.label: X Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the X axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: X Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the X axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Step Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO step pin for the Y axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Dir Pin
advanced_inputs.description: Runtime GPIO direction pin for the Y axis driver.

advanced_inputs.label: Limit Switch Layout
advanced_inputs.description: Choose whether the XY gantry uses 2 shared/home switches or 4 end-stop switches.

advanced_inputs.label: X Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: X Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the X maximum limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Min Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y minimum/home limit switch.

advanced_inputs.label: Y Max Limit Pin
advanced_inputs.description: GPIO pin for the Y maximum limit switch.

outputs.label: Next
outputs.description: Continue when the XY move completes.

protocol: Serial commands: PING, SET XY PINS <xStep> <xDir> <yStep> <yDir>, SET XY LIMITS <mode> <xMin> <xMax> <yMin> <yMax>, MOVE XY <xCm> <yCm> <speedProfile>.
notes: This board workspace owns the XY gantry movement function. Runtime pin and limit inputs are sent to the ESP32 before each move.
